BRAKE REAR SPEED SENSOR
(c) Remove the 2 clamp bolts holding the sensor harness
from the lower arm and body.
Torque:
Lower arm side: 19 N.m (195 kgf.cm, 14 ft•lbt)
Body side: 8.0 N,m (82 kgf,cm, 71 in.•lbt)
(d) Replace the sensor wire harness with the grommet.
